overview: Six slow days on the Spice Island, planned for two. After a night in historic Stone Town you move to a beach villa on the north coast for four nights of white sand, warm water and quiet dinners. A sunset dhow cruise, a spice farm visit and a private beach dinner are included, with free days to simply rest.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zanzibar, Stone Town stay
itinerary.description: Your driver meets you at Abeid Amani Karume Airport and takes you to a boutique hotel in Stone Town. Evening walk to the Forodhani food market.
itinerary.meta: Meals: dinner · Stay: boutique hotel, Stone Town

itinerary.title: Stone Town and spice farm
itinerary.description: A guided walk through Stone Town's alleys, the old slave market and the House of Wonders, then a spice farm tour. Afternoon transfer to your beach villa in Nungwi.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, lunch · Stay: beach villa, Nungwi

itinerary.title: Free beach day
itinerary.description: A full day to rest by the pool or on the beach. Optional snorkelling at Mnemba Atoll can be added.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, dinner · Stay: beach villa, Nungwi

itinerary.title: Sunset dhow cruise
itinerary.description: Late afternoon sailing on a traditional dhow with drinks and fruit as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, dinner · Stay: beach villa, Nungwi

itinerary.title: Private beach dinner
itinerary.description: Free day, followed by a private candlelit dinner set up on the sand.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, dinner · Stay: beach villa, Nungwi

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Relaxed morning, then your transfer to the airport for your flight back to Lagos.

faqs.q: Do Nigerians need a visa for Tanzania?
faqs.a: Yes. Nigerian passport holders need a Tanzanian e-visa. We prepare and submit it with you.
No. Anniversaries and couples' trips are welcome. We adjust the extras to suit you.

faqs.q: Can we extend the beach stay?
faqs.a: Yes. Extra nights can be added and we include them in your quote.

quickFacts.bestSeason: June to October, December to February
